description.text: standing behind a worn wooden shop counter, one hand resting flat on the counter top. The space behind him is simple and uncluttered: a pale wall, a narrow shelf, and the dim depth of the shop beyond the counter. The light is low and warm, catching the counter's worn grain and the fabric of his dark work shirt, while the far side of the room stays in soft shadow. The counter top has visible wear along its front edge and a faint sheen where his hand rests. He stands squarely and looks up at the person across from him. His expression is calm and direct. He speaks evenly, jaw and mouth moving in plain, close-mic clarity while the rest of his body stays still. The line completes within this shot, leaving a short breath of silence before the cut.
